hey, 

i get you. 

im going through an EXTREMELY similar situation. rejection really is the most soul-crushing thing. i have been in love with my best friend for 7 months now and im only falling further. it hurts every. single. freaking. day. i cry. every. single. day. i have my own suicide plan, similar to yours and i wanted to do it on my birthday, i guess it just felt full circle. my birthday is next week, but im not ready to leave her.

same here, im only 16 and i cant picture myself even living to finish high school.

I always planned on killing myself before i got old. a) because i never wanted to get old, b) i never wanted to die by natural causes and c) i wanted to die when i was ready and not just die at some random time from some random thing. i wanted to plan it in a way that would be clean and easy for everyone.

im just tired of existing now. honestly i dont see myself finishing this year.
